title: cerastium lanigerum f. isophyllum
intro: Cerastium lanigerum f. isophyllum, commonly known as the woolly mouse-ear, is a plant species that belongs to the family Caryophyllaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The health benefits of Cerastium lanigerum f. isophyllum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
